changelog: FIX: _productosMap invalidated after saveProductos — productoOf() returns fresh data.
FIX: Product objects no longer mutated in-place — shallow clone in renderGestorCatalog, renderAdminCatalog, buildCatalogHTML.
FIX: PDF print dialog no longer fires twice — added 'printed' flag guard.
FIX: _isSendingAdminVale reset in finally block — prevents permanent block on admin vale send.
FIX: Estafa modal close uses this.closest() instead of overly broad .modal-bg[style] selector.
FIX: Initials generation handles double/trailing spaces — split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).
FIX: Rank notification array index clamped with Math.max(0, ...) — prevents negative index.
FIX: callback === null changed to callback == null — handles undefined from restored queue items.
FIX: parseFloat || '' replaced with isNaN check — $0 commission no longer cleared.
FIX: Phone normalization regex changed from [567] to [57] — invalid prefix 6 no longer gets +53.
FIX: init() promise rejection caught — prevents unhandled promise rejection.
